purpose: Move reference detail for the dashboard's Pokémon Profile move descriptions and Matchup-tab damage calculator. Dashboard-support reference data, not a release-gated core entity.

fields.name: move_name
fields.description: Move display name, matching tournament_team_member's moves list entries

fields.name: power
fields.description: Base power; null for status/variable-power moves

fields.name: accuracy
fields.description: Accuracy percentage; null for moves that always hit

fields.name: category
fields.description: Damage class: physical, special, or status

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Source URL or endpoint the record was resolved from

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this row was published under
